name: Archive the real failed mission and prepare one finite legitimate retry

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p and p:IsTurnActive() and type(ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary)=='table'

steps.code: local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; local d=b.EnemyRetryDiagnosis(); assert(d.spyID==655368 and d.eventID==0 and d.eventTurn==23 and d.mission.turn==23,'preserved real mission checkpoint differs'); assert(d.mode=='PRODUCE' or d.mode=='RETURN' or d.mode=='MAP' or (d.mode=='CAPACITY_MAP' and d.currentID~=d.spyID and d.capacity==2 and d.occupied==2 and d.captive and d.captive.captor==1 and d.captive.nameIndex==-1 and d.roster.capturedPlaceholder and #d.roster.map==1 and #d.roster.activeOffMap==0),'native retry unavailable: '..d.mode..' '..d.outcome); b.Queue('BEGIN_SPY_RETRY'); return 'archive of failed native mission queued'

condition.code: local a=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.lastAction; if a=='ERROR_BEGIN_SPY_RETRY' or a=='UNKNOWN_BEGIN_SPY_RETRY' or a=='REJECTED_BEGIN_SPY_RETRY' then error(a) end; return a=='ACCEPTED_BEGIN_SPY_RETRY'

steps.code: local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; local r=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_ENEMY_SPY_RETRY')); assert(r.current==2 and r.archive.eventID==0 and r.archive.eventTurn==23 and r.archive.spyID==655368,'failed mission archive changed'); if r.mode=='CAPACITY_MAP' then local s=b.ReadEnemy(); assert(r.binding and r.binding.source=='BUILDING_GOV_SPIES' and r.binding.spyID==r.spyID and r.spyID~=655368 and s.spy and s.spy.present and s.spy.id==r.spyID and #s.spyRoster.captured==1 and s.spyRoster.capturedPlaceholder and s.spyRoster.physicalCount==2,'native second spy binding or old captive missing'); local stage=b.RetryLivingSpy(); assert(stage=='HOME_READY' or stage=='WAIT_NATIVE_READY','new native spy is not ready to resume: '..stage); return r.mode..' '..stage end; return r.mode
